text:
Brock Boeser became the eighth Canuck to reach 500 points on Friday, per RG.org, and The Hockey News gathered the room's reaction under the headline "He Deserves It." The milestone came off his work on the wall: Daniel Wagner of Pass it to Bulis wrote "Great play for Boeser’s 500th point" after Boeser fed Zeev Buium for the shot Elias Pettersson tipped in. Every one of those points has come in Vancouver, and he is on a six-game point streak for a team that has lost nine of ten.

The finishing is running ahead of the chances. Seven goals on 4.82 expected goals (the quality of his chances) is a 21.2% shooting rate, well above our range for him, and 11 of his 18 points have come on the power play. Five-on-five is the worry: Vancouver gets 36.4% of the expected goals with him on the ice, 4.8 points worse than without him. Evolving-Hockey saw a version of that last season (opponents created more with him out there) while noting he skates with teammates in the bottom 6%. Vancouver Hockey Daily is already asking what his pace means for his Canucks future.
headline: Brock Boeser reaches 500 points, all as a Canuck
